original_ai_output.title_zh: 纳萨拉瓦州APC与SDP就政治暴力相互指责
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚纳萨拉瓦州全体进步大会党（APC）与社会民主党（SDP）就据称的政治暴力事件相互指责。此前，APC支持者在拉菲亚举行和平抗议，要求警方和国家安全局调查针对该党成员及副总统卡希姆·谢蒂马的袭击。抗议者称反对党支持者多次发动袭击，但相关指控尚未得到证实。

key_facts.fact: 纳萨拉瓦州APC与SDP就据称的政治暴力相互指责

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Thousands of APC supporters, led by the state chairman, Aliyu Bello, on Monday staged a peaceful protest in Lafia

key_facts.fact: 抗议者要求警方和国家安全局调查副总统谢蒂马访问期间遭到的袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: calling on the police and the Department of State Services to investigate the attack on Shettima during his visit to the state for the presidential campaign rally last Wednesday

key_facts.fact: APC方面称该党遭受了据称由反对党支持者实施的多次袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: had experienced several attacks allegedly carried out by opposition supporters
